name: First Spring Under Heaven (天下第一泉)
verdict: 'First Spring Under Heaven' (Baotu Spring) scenic-area brand promoted on the shirt front; the scenic area is managed and operated by Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group, a first-level municipal state-owned enterprise of Jinan. New front sponsor of Shandong Taishan for the 2026 CSL season.

why.text: The 'First Spring Under Heaven' scenic area advertised on the shirt front is managed and operated by Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group, a first-level municipal state-owned enterprise established by the Jinan municipal government. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations were committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So the money behind the shirt front is the Chinese state's.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China’s large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.

note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of Shandong Taishan in the 2026 Chinese Super League season (named press: Tencent News / 九五体育, 2026-03-17; the shirt advertises the club owner's 'First Spring Under Heaven' scenic area — Baotu Spring). Rating note: proposed 'serious' — the Chinese state controls the sponsor (the link, claims first-spring-scenic-area-jctg-operations + jctg-jinan-sasac-ownership: the brand is a scenic area managed and operated by Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group, a first-level municipal state-owned enterprise established by the Jinan municipal government; METHOD.md counts control), and the record (claim china-xinjiang-un-assessment: UN OHCHR 2022 Xinjiang assessment plus Human Rights Watch 2026) is documented for that state. ON HOLD: awaits a maintainer's review (tier set by maintainers). Further detail, kept out of the rating claims: a single report (山东财经报道, carried 2026-07-21 by Sohu/金融界 and The Paper) states the Jinan municipal SASAC holds 93.19% of the group and is its largest shareholder and actual controller (Shandong Caixin Asset Operation 6.81%); no second independent publisher for that sentence was found, so the tier rests on the municipal-SOE ownership claim instead.
